historical_commentary.text: 4D Chart as described here is a legacy component that has been superseded by more modern charting approaches in current 4D (including web-based charting libraries and later graph area object types), so the specific CT DO COMMAND-based drawing API is largely obsolete for new development. The underlying idea — computing radial/polar coordinates to render a Kiviat-style visualization — remains conceptually valid and is easily portable to any modern drawing or charting library.
related_updates: 4D Chart's classic drawing-primitive API has been superseded by newer charting options in current 4D, including web-based JS charting libraries embedded via web areas
The general radar/Kiviat chart technique (polar coordinate math) is a standard, tool-agnostic charting pattern still used today in modern charting libraries
